apps_analyzed.title: Focus To-Do
apps_analyzed.verdict: Mid — sync paywalls + reorder feature missing + watch bugs

apps_analyzed.title: Focus Keeper
apps_analyzed.verdict: Vulnerable but tiny install base — old Apple-port that didn't translate; opportunity small

verbatims_top.text: A conceited developer who doesn't answer questions. He doesn't even bother to comment on why he didn't add this reordering feature that's found in every app. A to-do list without reordering.

such a stupid reasoning from the developer. so the syncing is a premium option. when you're in a group and you focus for hours. it doesn't sync so you're left with 0 minutes!! how stupid is that!! what's the point of groups then??

Isn't it counterproductive to have ads on the very screen that is supposed to be a focus screen? The whole point is to avoid distractions and lock in and that can't happen with Ads dancing around the screen.

verdict.best_vulnerable_cell: Focus To-Do (10M+, 16.5% recent low) — but signal is mild and complaints are feature-gap (sync, reorder), not strategic vulnerability
verdict.market_state: SATURATED — most mid-tier pomodoro apps are healthy (4.4-4.8★, low_pct under 10%). Niche is well-served by indie devs (Goodtime open-source-style 4.8★). New entrant has no obvious wedge.
verdict.build_complexity: 3-5 weeks (truly trivial — countdown + notification + simple stats)
verdict.ranking_vs_v9_top6: BELOW — saturated, no displacement signal, no monetization angle (users expect free)
